claim: Two Night 6 runs of binding h -- the binding that reached 6 AM on 2026-09-13 with 42/42 cycles -- died on 2026-09-20 to the SAME mechanism, identified on the retained video in both cases: a defence that needs five continuous fully-masked one-second ticks got in, because h holds the mask fully on for 4811 ms and five whole-second boundaries fit in that span only at a lucky phase. Holding it 300 ms longer (h2, 5111 ms, five ticks at every phase) reached 6 AM on the first attempt and unlocked Custom Night. Runs --machine-only (explicit MODEL_ONLY machine-input experiment, promotion suppressed).

binding.note: The tracked winner emits the 2026-09-13 plan byte for byte (diff against artifacts/night6-anchored-h/bundle/night-6.plan is empty) but hashes differently, because observeUntilMs gained a KNOBS0 default after the bundle was built. ANCHOR_AIMS is keyed on stableHash(winner), so anchorAimFor refused the tracked winner for five days and every Night 6 attempt since had to be hand-fed 4870/5000/0 through the environment.

runs.chain: plant-model.js:677 -- `if (this.power <= 0 || this.blackout.active || this.maskFullyOn || this.bb.inside) this.hallLit = false;`. Once Balloon Boy is inside, the flashlight cannot light, so the 9960 hall flash that repels Withered Foxy is a no-op for the rest of the night. This also explains the open `0 visible hall flashes in 43 intervals` reading: after BB is in, there is nothing to see.

mechanism.rule: VENT_MASK_TICKS = 5 (packages/core/src/mechanics/config.js:95). plant-model.js:1551 increments the counter on `this.frame % C.FPS === 0` while `maskFullyOn`, and g293 zeroes it on every entry into the fully-on state, so the five ticks must be five whole-second boundaries inside ONE continuous fully-on span.
mechanism.deliveredPhase: schedule T0 at onset + 4871.18 ms, so the fully-on span is [onset + 9320.18, onset + 14131.18] + n*10000. Boundaries at 10000, 11000, 12000, 13000, 14000: exactly five, clearing the mask-off press by 131.18 ms and the fully-on start by 679.82 ms.
mechanism.why131IsThin: That 131 ms is GAME-FRAME time, not wall time: the counter advances on frame % 60. Roughly eight dropped frames inside a cycle move the fifth tick past the mask-off press and the cycle silently delivers four. Nothing in the model can produce that, which is why the model scores h 3000/3000 with bb.inside false.
mechanism.floorAlreadyInTheTree: tools/device/test-runner-plan.mjs:165 requires the minus7 driver's MASK_RESPONSE_HOLD_MS to equal round(1000 * (MASK_ANIM_ON / FPS + VENT_MASK_TICKS)) = 5200 ms, `the response floor must cover the sourced raise animation and five one-second ticks`. minus-toys holds 5011 ms press-to-press and was never measured against it.

fix.phaseIndependent: A span of 5111 ms contains at least five whole-second boundaries at every phase (5000 ms is the floor), so the fifth tick no longer depends on where the anchor happened to land, with 111 ms of frame-time slack on top.
fix.costedFrom: the idle gap between mask-off and the hall flash, 700 ms -> 400 ms. That is still more than twice the measured 180 ms mask-to-other seam (actuator.mjs, 0 of 17 lost at 180 ms or more). No wind hold was touched.
fix.goldenRuleCheck: Pedro's rule is that more mask comes out of less winding. Here the mask was bought from idle instead, and the version that DID buy it from the wind is refuted below.
